day.headline: A Dragon day — Rat and Monkey are in step.

reasons: Rooster pairs with Dragon — a harmonious day
signs.motif: the note in your own handwriting
signs.message: You left yourself a note in your own scrawl. Obey it.

reasons: Dragon's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: a mug abandoned in the kitchen
signs.message: Deal with someone else's cup first. Sets the whole morning going.

reasons: Rat and Dragon share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Cold coffee in your own cup. Dump it, make another, go.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Five minutes left in it. That's when you say the thing.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the last hour of the afternoon
signs.message: Late afternoon's the workable part. Pick one small thing, finish it.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: The desktop folder holding everything. Empty half of it, fifteen minutes.

reasons: Monkey and Dragon share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: That renewal hits this week. Look at it before it decides.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You've boiled it twice now. Pour the cup this time.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You built a playlist for one chore. Just play it, chore optional.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the lid that no longer fits
signs.message: The lid stopped fitting months ago. Not today's problem, leave it.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Two minutes away. Keep your pace, the bench is right there.

reasons: Dog opposes Dragon — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Whatever's left of the good thing goes tonight. Nowhere to be.
